description_en: Creates an Analyzer to perform over-privilege or external access analysis on an account or resource directory
description_zh: 创建一个新的Analyzer对账号或资源目录进行过度授权或外部访问分析
kebab_example: aliyun accessanalyzer create-analyzer --analyzer-name MyAnalyzer --type ExternalAccess --scope Account --configuration '{"OverPrivilegedConfiguration":{"UnusedAccessAge":90}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAnalyzer

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Analyzer. Valid values:
ExternalAccess: external access.
OverPrivileged: over-privilege
parameters.help_zh: Analyzer类型，合法值：ExternalAccess（外部访问）、OverPrivileged（过度授权）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The scan scope of the Analyzer. Valid values:
Account: account.
ResourceDirectory: resource directory
parameters.help_zh: Analyzer扫描范围，合法值：Account（账号）、ResourceDirectory（资源目录）
parameters.name: scope

fields.help_en: The unused access period. Default value: 90. Valid values: 1 to 365. Unit: days
fields.help_zh: 闲置访问周期，默认90天，支持1到365天
fields.name: unused_access_age

fields.help_en: The configuration information for the OverPrivileged type
fields.name: over_privileged_configuration

parameters.help_en: The configuration information of the Analyzer instance
parameters.name: configuration
